程序包 com.badlogic.gdx.graphics.g3d.utils

类 AnimationController.AnimationDesc

java.lang.Object
com.badlogic.gdx.graphics.g3d.utils.AnimationController.AnimationDesc
封闭类:
AnimationController
public static class AnimationController.AnimationDesc extends Object
Class describing how to play and Animation. You can read the values within this class to get the progress of the animation. Do not change the values. Only valid when the animation is currently played.
